span.normalized: On December 16, 2024, Qualcomm amended its complaint to add allegations relating to an Arm notice of breach of the Qualcomm ALA and related tort and anti-competition claims. In 2025, Qualcomm amended its complaint again to add claims relating to an alleged breach of Qualcomm’s Technology License Agreement.
